newsitem.title: USA: SciClone sets shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: SciClone sets shareholder rights plan.

text.p: SciClone Pharmaceuticals Inc Tuesday said it adopted a preferred stock rights purchase plan to help shareholders facing a company takeover.
In a statement, SciClone said the rights distribution is not in response to an effort to acquire the company.
Under the plan, shareholders will receive the right to purchase one one-hundredth of a share of preferred stock for each outstanding common share held on August 15, 1997.
The rights would be exercisable at $30.00 per right after a person or group acquired or offered to acquire 15 percent or more of SciClone common in a deal not approved by the board.
